title: Alcohol-Procedure Violation Disputes, Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, an alcohol-procedure dispute that stands submitted concerns the account's most recent alcohol-procedure violation and is decided by the agent on the records of that violation's batch and of the account: the decision removes the alcohol-procedure excusal points from the violation, booked as one cleared entry with removal reason "dispute upheld", and marks the dispute upheld.

An alcohol-procedure violation is the handing over of alcohol without completing the ID scan.

## Before and after the decision

| Record | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| The dispute | Submitted | Upheld |
| The most recent alcohol-procedure violation | Recorded with its points | Carries a cleared entry for the excusal points |
| Active violation points | Unchanged | Lower by the excusal points |

## Tool: `decide_alcohol_procedure_dispute_63dedfc1`

**Capability.** Decides a shopper's submitted dispute of an alcohol-procedure violation in the shopper's favour and takes the given number of violation points off that violation. One call books one cleared entry against the disputed violation with removal reason `dispute_upheld` and the points removed, lowers the account's active violation points by the same number, and marks the dispute as upheld.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `decide_alcohol_procedure_dispute_63dedfc1` and then calls it; it is an agent-side tool.

**Parameters.**

- `shopper_account_id` — the shopper contractor account number the dispute belongs to, as returned by the shopper account lookup for the verified caller (account reference, text).
- `shopper_appeal_id` — the reference number of the submitted violation dispute being decided, as returned by the shopper appeals lookup (dispute reference, text).
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the disputed alcohol-procedure violation entry, as shown on the dispute and in the shopper account entries lookup (entry reference, text).
- `points` — the violation points taken off the disputed violation: a whole non-negative integer, no decimals and no sign; the active points fall by exactly this integer.

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("dispute_upheld" when the decision was booked), `clearing_entry_id`, `shopper_appeal_id` and `source_event_id` (echoed back), `points_removed`, `violation_points_balance` (the active violation points after the decision) and `event_date` (the decision date, YYYY-MM-DD).
